name: scdaw_edit_audio_clip
description: Perform non-destructive editing on audio clips: split, trim, duplicate, join, equal-power crossfade, set fade-in/fade-out curves, edit clip gain envelopes, silence ranges, mute, or remove.

thresholdDb.description: Silence threshold in dBFS (default -40, for action='split_at_silences')

minDurationSec.description: Minimum silence duration in seconds (default 0.25, for action='split_at_silences')

clipIds.description: List of clip IDs to join (for action='join')

splitBeat.description: Beat position where clip is split (for action='split')

durationBeats.description: Crossfade overlap duration in beats (for action='crossfade')

points.description: Full replacement gain envelope points [{ time, value }]

point.description: Single gain envelope point { time, value } to upsert

removeTime.description: Relative time in seconds of envelope point to remove
